title: Kite Day Tangle
story: A stiff May breeze on Kite Day sent three kites swooping over the town green, then into one another, then into a single glorious knot. Teddy took eleven photos of it before he remembered that one of the kites was his. Before anyone starts tugging, untangle the knot on paper: who flew which kite, with which tail?

texts: The flier who chose bows is neither Teddy nor Una.
Una flew either the dragon or the box kite.
Una chose either tassels or bows for a tail.
The dragon kite's flier chose streamers for a tail.

trace.text: Clue 4 says directly that the dragon kite goes with the tail of streamers.
The tail of bows must go with Hugo: clue 1 rules out Teddy and Una.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Una must go with the tail of tassels: clue 1 rules out the tail of bows; clue 3 rules out the tail of streamers.
Teddy must go with the tail of streamers: clue 1 rules out the tail of bows; the tail of tassels already goes with Una.
The dragon kite goes with the tail of streamers, so the dragon kite also goes with Teddy.
Una must go with the box kite: clue 2 rules out the diamond kite; the dragon kite already goes with Teddy.
Hugo must go with the diamond kite: the dragon kite is already ruled out for the tail of streamers; the box kite already goes with Una.
The box kite must go with the tail of tassels: the tail of bows is already ruled out for Hugo; the tail of streamers already goes with the dragon kite.
The diamond kite must go with the tail of bows: the other choices are already taken.
